result.instructions: Tools for Mathpix, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Turn the equation in this image into LaTeX: https://example.com/equation.png"; "Convert the PDF at this public URL into Markdown and show me the first section."; "Which documents did I convert this week, and did any of them fail?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Mathpix data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run mathpix_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run mathpix_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run mathpix_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. mathpix_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: mathpix_get_usage
tools.title: Get API usage
tools.description: API usage counts for this Mathpix account over a date range, grouped by usage type (image, image-async, pdf ...), request arguments or app id and aggregated by a timespan. Use it to reconcile billing and watch consumption. Free to call. GET /v3/ocr-usage.

group_by.description: What to group the counts by (default usage_type).

timespan.description: Aggregation period, a lowercase word such as month (default), week or day. Mathpix rejects values it does not know.

tools.name: mathpix_list_image_results
tools.title: List image OCR results
tools.description: Search and list stored results of earlier image/strokes OCR requests (/v3/text etc.), newest first: the recognized text, confidence, detected content types and the request options. Requests made with improve_mathpix=false are not stored. Free to call. GET /v3/ocr-results.

from_date.description: Only results at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

to_date.description: Only results before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

text.description: Only results whose recognized text contains this string.

tags.description: Only results carrying these tags (as set on the OCR request).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: mathpix_list_documents
tools.title: List processed documents
tools.description: List documents previously submitted for async processing (/v3/pdf), newest first: pdf_id, input file or URL, status (received, loaded, split, completed, error), page counts and timestamps. Use the pdf_id with the get/output tools. Free to call. GET /v3/pdf-results.

from_date.description: Only documents at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

to_date.description: Only documents before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: mathpix_get_document_status
tools.title: Get document status
tools.description: Processing status of a submitted document: status (received, loaded, split, completed, error), pages done, and the status of each requested conversion. Poll this until status is completed before reading the output (percent_done reaches 100 before the output files exist). Free to call. GET /v3/pdf/{pdf_id}.

pdf_id.description: The pdf_id returned by mathpix_submit_document or listed by mathpix_list_documents.

tools.name: mathpix_get_conversion_status
tools.title: Get conversion status
tools.description: Status of the output-format conversions of a document (the pdf_id) or of a Markdown conversion (the conversion_id): one entry per requested format with status processing, completed or error. Free to call. GET /v3/converter/{id}.

id.description: A pdf_id, or the conversion_id returned by mathpix_convert_markdown.

tools.name: mathpix_get_document_output
tools.title: Get document output
tools.description: Read the TEXT result of a processed document: mmd (Mathpix Markdown, the primary output), md (plain Markdown), html, latex (single .tex) or lines.json (line-by-line data with geometry). Long outputs come back in slices (offset / next_offset). Binary formats (docx, pdf, zip, images) cannot be fetched through this server. Only call once mathpix_get_document_status says completed. Free to call. GET /v3/pdf/{pdf_id}.{ext}.

id.description: The pdf_id of a completed document.

format.description: Output format: mmd, md, html, latex, lines.json.

offset.description: Character offset to start from (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset to read on.

max_chars.description: Characters to return, up to 45000 (default 40000); fewer come back when the text needs heavy escaping, so always continue from next_offset.

tools.name: mathpix_get_conversion_output
tools.title: Get Markdown conversion output
tools.description: Read the TEXT result of a Markdown conversion started with mathpix_convert_markdown: md, html or latex. Long outputs come back in slices (offset / next_offset). Binary formats cannot be fetched through this server. Free to call. GET /v3/converter/{conversion_id}.{ext}.

offset.description: Character offset to start from (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset to read on.

max_chars.description: Characters to return, up to 45000 (default 40000); fewer come back when the text needs heavy escaping, so always continue from next_offset.

tools.name: mathpix_ocr_image
tools.title: OCR an image (billed)
tools.description: BILLED BY MATHPIX (pay as you go, per image; see mathpix.com/pricing/api): recognize math, text, tables and chemistry in ONE image and return Mathpix Markdown (LaTeX math inside \( \) / \[ \]), and optionally HTML, styled LaTeX or structured data. The image must be a public URL (or a small data URI); local files are not reachable. Each call is a new billed request. POST /v3/text.

src.description: Image to read: a PUBLIC http(s) URL that Mathpix can download (up to 10 MB), or a data:image/png|jpeg|gif|webp|bmp|tiff;base64,... string (up to 1000000 characters; prefer a URL). This server cannot read local files.

formats.description: Output formats (default: text = Mathpix Markdown). data = extracted asciimath/mathml/latex/svg/tsv; latex_styled = single-equation LaTeX.

enable_document_layout.description: true for a full page (lists, multi-line layout); default is snippet mode.

include_smiles.description: true to read chemistry diagrams as <smiles> notation.

include_line_data.description: true to also return line-by-line data with positions (larger reply).

tags.description: Tags stored with the result, searchable with mathpix_list_image_results.

improve_mathpix.description: Set false to opt this request out of Mathpix using the image/document to improve its models (it then also will not appear in the results-query tools). Omit to use the account default.

tools.name: mathpix_submit_document
tools.title: Submit a document (billed)
tools.description: BILLED BY MATHPIX (pay as you go, per page processed; see mathpix.com/pricing/api): start async conversion of a PDF, DOCX, PPTX, EPUB or similar document at a PUBLIC URL into Mathpix Markdown. Returns a pdf_id immediately; poll mathpix_get_document_status until completed, then read it with mathpix_get_document_output. Use page_ranges to limit the pages billed. Each call is a new billed job. POST /v3/pdf.

url.description: PUBLIC http(s) URL where Mathpix can download the document (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, EPUB, ... up to 1 GB). This server cannot read local files.

page_ranges.description: Pages to process (and be billed for), e.g. "2,4-6"; "2 - -2" = page 2 to the next-to-last. Default: all pages.

include_smiles.description: Read chemistry diagrams as <smiles> notation (default true at Mathpix).

improve_mathpix.description: Set false to opt this request out of Mathpix using the image/document to improve its models (it then also will not appear in the results-query tools). Omit to use the account default.

tools.name: mathpix_convert_markdown
tools.title: Convert Markdown
tools.description: Convert Mathpix Markdown (MMD) text into plain Markdown, HTML or LaTeX. Returns a conversion_id; read the result with mathpix_get_conversion_output (check mathpix_get_conversion_status first). Conversions may be billed by Mathpix under your plan; see mathpix.com/pricing/api. Each call creates a new conversion. POST /v3/converter.

mmd.description: The Mathpix Markdown text to convert (up to 500000 characters).

formats.description: Output formats to produce: md, html and/or latex.

improve_mathpix.description: Set false to opt this request out of Mathpix using the image/document to improve its models (it then also will not appear in the results-query tools). Omit to use the account default.

tools.name: mathpix_delete_document
tools.title: Delete a document
tools.description: PERMANENTLY delete a processed document's output at Mathpix (Markdown, JSON lines, images, all converted formats) and the uploaded source copy. Cannot be undone; read what you need first. Only billing metadata is kept. DELETE /v3/pdf/{pdf_id}.

pdf_id.description: The pdf_id of the document to delete.

tools.name: mathpix_delete_conversion
tools.title: Delete a Markdown conversion
tools.description: PERMANENTLY delete the output files of a Markdown conversion at Mathpix. Cannot be undone; read what you need first. DELETE /v3/converter/{conversion_id}.

conversion_id.description: The conversion_id of the conversion to delete.
